label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled state parameter flows into session attribute key retrieval. The redirect value comes from request.getSession().getAttribute("oauth_state_" + state) where state is user-supplied. Although state is validated against ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,64}$ preventing direct script injection in the key, the session attribute VALUE stored under that key could contain attacker-controlled data from previous requests. The sendRedirect(redirect) reflects this unvalidated session value back to the client, enabling open redirect/XSS via the redirect target.

evidence.note: User state param flows into session attribute key, then session value is retrieved and sent via redirect
